articles.title: ‘I felt disgusted’: MEP speaks out over nude deepfakes and urges EU action
articles.summary:
Lena Schilling of Austrian Greens says images are ‘digital violence against women’ and a threat to democracy

An Austrian MEP has spoken out about her experience of being “stripped naked” online without her consent and has urged the EU to take action, as a report found that one in six female MEPs had been targeted by sexualised AI-generated content.

Lena Schilling of the Green party said she had learned last month about nude deepfakes of herself circulating online. When she opened the links, she found herself staring at images from one of her first ever press conferences – but the images had been digitally altered to remove her clothing.

articles.title: Ukraine war briefing: Trump’s sanctions waiver is a ‘60-day pause’ to analyse economic impact, says Rubio
articles.summary:
Ukraine’s Zelenskyy expects Trump to lift more sanctions against Russia. What we know on day 1,698

US secretary of state Marco Rubio has said that US President Donald Trump’s waiver of sweeping sanctions and tariffs on Russia would be a 60-day pause to “analyse” their impact on the global economy. Rubio said also no one at the White House ordered the slow down of the speed of Ukraine’s access to Starlink to prevent it from being used on drones flying faster than 100mph, referring to Starshield, the military version of Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite internet network.

“The president wants to take the 60-day period of time to sort of analyse what imposing both sanctions and tariffs will mean to the global economy and even to the US economy,” Rubio said, noting that the economic restrictions involved a number of countries, not just Russia. Pointing to high energy prices and the Iran war, “we need that period of time to sort of study all this and figure out what the right combination is,” he said.

Trump’s abrupt decision to waive sanctions on Russia days before they were to take effect drew outrage Saturday from members of Congress, which had overwhelmingly passed the legislation. Republican Senator Rick Scott said it was clear Russia was the aggressor, and said the US had “to do everything we can to put economic pressure on Russia”. On social media, fellow Republican Thom Tillis described the move as “beyond irresponsible” and a capitulation “to a Russian dictator who illegally invaded Ukraine”.

The Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy expects the Trump administration to lift more sanctions against Russia in the future and has called for Europe to establish its own negotiations with Moscow as the US has sought better ties and business deals with the Kremlin. “Unfortunately, the lifting of sanctions will continue, and I believe that the ‘diesel deal’ is the first step,” said Zelenskyy on Saturday. “Unfortunately, it seems to me that this cannot stop Putin; on the contrary, he feels joy and happiness that he has such support.”

Zelenskyy said Ukraine’s lead negotiator, Rustem Umerov, had met Friday with US presidential envoy Jared Kushner, Trump’s son-in-law. Zelenskyy said the US was working to arrange a three-way meeting involving him, Trump and Putin, potentially in the Middle East, Europe or the US.

Russian air defence ⁠units intercepted and destroyed nearly ⁠200 Ukrainian ⁠drones ​headed for Moscow on Saturday, ⁠Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said on Telegram. Sobyanin, ⁠in a long ​series ‌of ‌online posts, noted ‌that 195 drones had been destroyed since midnight, with emergency crews examining debris on ‌the ground. Russia’s civil aviation authority, ​Rosaviatsia, said two Moscow airports – Domodedovo and Vnukovo – had ⁠suspended flight operations.

Romania said Saturday it shot down two Russian drones over the Black Sea, the latest in a spate of incidents believed to be spillover from Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. Ships have been attacked in recent days by drones in the Black Sea off the coast of Romania and Bulgaria.

articles.title: Buildings set ablaze and more than 1,200 arrested as police clash with protesters across France

Police fire teargas in Paris and Limoges town hall ‘largely lost’ to fire – with officials blaming violence on ‘ultra-left’

More than 1,200 people were arrested in France on Saturday after protesters supporting high school students clashed with police, with some demonstrations later spiralling out of control as buildings were set ablaze and shops looted.

Police fired teargas in confrontations with protesters, as demonstrations across France were boosted by other groups angry about high prices and the fraying of a social welfare system. While hundreds of thousands protested peacefully in street marches in scores of cities, violent fringe groups targeted public buildings, luxury boutiques and supermarkets and attacked police vehicles and officers.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním rizikům kvůli pokračujícím útokům na ukrajinskou energetickou infrastrukturu navzdory údajným příměřím a rostoucímu napětí kolem černomořské dopravy. Politická nestabilita se projevuje v protestech, vnitřních sporech v EU a přetrvávajících debatách o financování obrany a využití zmrazených ruských aktiv. Makroekonomické prostředí zůstává poznamenáno obavami z inflace, vývojem úrokových sazeb ECB a politickými třenicemi ohledně zelené transformace.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating security risks due to ongoing attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure despite reported ceasefires and rising tensions surrounding Black Sea shipping. Political instability is manifesting through protests, internal EU disputes, and persistent debates over defense funding and the use of frozen Russian assets. The macroeconomic environment remains marked by inflation concerns, ECB interest rate trajectories, and political friction over the green transition.

archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in energy markets and diplomatic tug-of-wars over recent infrastructure attacks in Ukraine and the Black Sea are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícímu se bezpečnostnímu napětí v důsledku probíhající války na Ukrajině, která se rozšiřuje do kyberprostoru a kritické infrastruktury, včetně nedávných útoků na ruská datová centra a soudních procesů kvůli sabotáži Nord Streamu. Politická nestabilita roste vlivem sílících protestů ve Francii a politických tlaků krajní pravice napříč kontinentem, zatímco makroekonomické prostředí zatěžují rostoucí výdaje na obranu a utahování rozpočtů.

Political instability is growing due to intensifying protests in France and rising far-right political pressure across the continent, while the macroeconomic environment is strained by surging defense spending and tightening budgets.

archive.forecast_en: Continued cybersecurity tensions, escalating protests in France, and sharpened rhetoric regarding European defense readiness are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním rizikům kvůli ruským útokům na ukrajinskou energetickou infrastrukturu a technologickým omezením na frontě. Politická nestabilita roste v důsledku fiskálních tlaků ve Francii, sociálních nepokojů a rostoucího vlivu krajní pravice ohrožující financování Ukrajiny.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating security risks due to Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure and frontline technological restrictions. Political instability is growing amid fiscal pressures in France, social unrest, and the rising influence of the far-right threatening Ukraine funding.

archive.forecast_en: Persistent tension on the Ukrainian frontline, ongoing EU budget disputes, and market anxiety regarding French debt are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se geopolitickým a ekonomickým tlakům, podpořeným eskalací války na Ukrajině, kde Kyjev obnovuje údery na ruské rafinerie kvůli oslabené americké podpoře. Na domácí scéně zatěžují trhy obavy z francouzského dluhu a politické napětí, zatímco EU se potýká s rozpočtovými spory a krizí na hranicích.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating geopolitical and economic pressures driven by intensifying warfare in Ukraine as Kyiv resumes refinery strikes amid waning US intelligence sharing. Domestically, French fiscal worries and political strains weigh heavily on markets, while the EU grapples with stubborn budget disputes and border management challenges.

archive.forecast_en: Persistent market anxiety over French public debt, intensified frontline fighting in Ukraine, and ongoing friction in EU budget negotiations are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí eskaluje kvůli kolapsu energetického příměří na Ukrajině a obavám z omezení americké podpory a technologií v čele se Starlinkem. Evropští lídři na summitu v Bruselu řeší krizi kolem sedmiletého rozpočtu EU, rostoucí ceny energií a nátlak USA. Vnitřní stabilitu navíc zatěžují sociální protesty v Albánii a Francii či kontroverze kolem evropské migrační politiky.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions are escalating due to the collapse of the energy ceasefire in Ukraine and concerns over reduced US support and technologies, notably Starlink. European leaders at the Brussels summit are grappling with the EU's seven-year budget crisis, soaring energy prices, and US pressure. Furthermore, internal stability is strained by social protests in Albania and France, as well as controversies surrounding European migration policy.

archive.forecast_en: Continued market volatility is expected in the coming days in response to the escalation of the conflict in Ukraine and tense negotiations over the EU's seven-year budget in Brussels.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v Evropě a jejím okolí je nadále vysoce napjatá po incidentech s drony v černomořských vodách poblíž Rumunska a eskalaci útoků na energetickou infrastrukturu na Ukrajině. V EU probíhají ostré spory o sedmiletý rozpočet, daňové zátěže a klimatické politiky, což prohlubuje politickou nestabilitu. Roste také tlak na zvládání vysokých cen energií, které pohánějí populistické tendence napříč členskými státy.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in and around Europe remains highly tense following drone incidents in Black Sea waters near Romania and escalating strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Sharp disputes over the seven-year EU budget, tax burdens, and climate policies are deepening political instability within the bloc. Rising pressure to manage high energy prices is also fueling populist tendencies across member states.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající nervozitu na trzích kvůli bezpečnostním incidentům v Černém moři a pokračujícím debatám o rozpočtu EU.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí stupňujícímu se tlaku na energetických trzích, napětí v Černém moři po útocích dronů na tankery a složitým vyjednáváním o sedmiletém rozpočtu. archive.security_status_en: The European Union faces escalating pressure in energy markets, tensions in the Black Sea following drone attacks on tankers, and complex negotiations over the seven-year budget. U.S. rhetoric regarding the war in Ukraine and the potential easing of sanctions on Russia's 'shadow fleet' deepens concerns over Western alliance unity and energy supply stability.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající volatilitu na energetických trzích a stupňující se diplomatický tlak na dosažení kompromisu ohledně rozpočtu EU.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí rostoucímu napětí kvůli kolapsu energetického příměří na Ukrajině a patové situaci na summitu ohledně dlouhodobého rozpočtu a dodávek plynu. Mezitím geopolitické tlaky ze strany USA a eskalující konflikty vyvíjejí silný tlak na evropskou ekonomickou stabilitu i bezpečnostní architekturu.
archive.security_status_en: The European Union is facing mounting tension due to the collapse of the energy ceasefire in Ukraine and a deadlock at the summit regarding the long-term budget and gas supplies. Meanwhile, geopolitical pressures from the US and escalating conflicts place severe strain on European economic stability and security architecture.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na energetických trzích a stupňující se diplomatické třenice mezi USA a EU ohledně sankční politiky vůči Rusku.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí rostoucímu vnitřnímu napětí kvůli rozporům ohledně rozpočtu, migrace a energetické politiky, kterou komplikuje americko-ruská dohoda o dodávkách paliv. Rusko pokračuje v konfiskaci evropských aktiv a Ukrajina obnovila útoky na ruské ropné rafinérie, což vyvolalo ostrou kritiku ze strany USA. Russia continues to seize European assets and Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries, drawing sharp criticism from the US. Simultaneously, social unrest and youth and Yellow Vest protests are mounting in France, while strong migratory pressure persists at the EU's external borders.

archive.forecast_en: Persistent tensions in energy markets and further diplomatic clashes between the US and the EU over renewed oil refinery strikes are expected in the coming days. Social unrest in France and debates over migration policy will continue to weigh on the union's political stability.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním a ekonomickým tlakům, podpořeným novými ruskými útoky na ukrajinskou infrastrukturu a rostoucím napětím ve vztazích s USA ohledně války na Ukrajině. Vnitřní stabilitu unie navíc zatěžují sociální nepokoje ve Francii a Albánii, rostoucí výnosy francouzských dluhopisů blížící se 5 % a sílící politický tlak na přísnější migrační politiku.

Internal stability is further strained by social unrest in France and Albania, surging French bond yields approaching 5%, and intensifying political momentum for stricter migration controls.

archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, continued diplomatic friction between the US and EU regarding Ukraine and heightened pressure to address the French budgetary crisis are expected. Social tensions and security incidents will continue to occupy EU leaders.

Evropští představitelé na summitu v Bruselu upevnili jednotu a řeší přísnější pravidla pro nelegální migraci i nové obchodní dohody, zatímco Rusko stupňuje útoky na ukrajinskou infrastrukturu a zabíjí evropský majetek.
archive.security_status_en: EU-US relations are souring due to tensions over Ukraine funding and support, alongside restrictions on Starlink access. European leaders solidified unity at the Brussels summit, addressing tighter rules on irregular migration and new trade deals, while Russia intensifies attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and seizes European corporate assets.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické manévry ohledně pomoci Ukrajině a vyjednávání o unijním rozpočtu. Růst napětí v transatlantických vztazích bude nadále určovat ekonomickou agendu EU.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, further diplomatic maneuvers regarding aid to Ukraine and negotiations over the EU budget are expected. Rising tensions in transatlantic relations will continue to shape the EU's economic agenda.

Současně se EU potýká s vnitřními ekonomickými tlaky, dohodami o automobilových subvenčních pravidlech a rostoucími obavami z energetické a migrační krize.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating geopolitical tension due to uncertain U.S. support for Ukraine under Donald Trump and Russian efforts to enforce a non-negotiable security zone. Simultaneously, the EU is grappling with internal economic pressures, agreements on automotive subsidy rules, and mounting concerns over energy and migration.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat intenzivní diplomatické snahy EU o zajištění alternativního financování pro Ukrajinu a reakce na omezení technologií ze strany USA. Pozornost trhů se soustředí na fiskální a energetická jednání na úrovni unijních institucí.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, intensive EU diplomatic efforts to secure alternative financing for Ukraine and responses to U.S. technology restrictions are expected. Market attention will focus on fiscal and energy negotiations at the EU institutional level.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí roste kvůli posunům v americké politice vůči Rusku a Ukrajině, což nutí EU urychleně hledat vlastní finanční i technologická řešení včetně zajištění satelitní konektivity. Evropská ekonomika čelí fiskálním tlakům, napjatým politickým koalicím (např. v Německu a Španělsku) a probíhajícím protestům mladé generace. Itálie mezitím úspěšně vyjednala unijní dohodu na snížení cen elektřiny, zatímco francouzsko-německá automobilová dohoda chrání domácí výrobce.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions are mounting due to shifts in U.S. policy toward Russia and Ukraine, forcing the EU to urgently seek independent financial and technological solutions, including satellite connectivity. The European economy faces fiscal pressures, strained political coalitions (such as in Germany and Spain), and ongoing youth protests. Meanwhile, Italy successfully negotiated an EU deal to lower electricity prices, while a French-German auto agreement protects domestic manufacturers.
